title: Teaching Language Models to Narrow Boolean Patent Searches from Search Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.22270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patent prior-art searchers issue Boolean queries line by line, broadening to find relevant documents and narrowing until candidates can be screened. We distill 38,397 Japan Patent Office search reports into executable expert strategies, re-execute them, and evaluate generated strategies by citation recall and the smallest set containing each citation. Prompted models write valid, high-recall strategies but leave citations in sets too large to screen. We adapt a generator offline from scored rollouts in two forms: strategy-level learning from a screening-aware strategy score, and line-level learning from citation-preserving narrowing credit, which upweights the query lines keeping a found citation in a smaller set. On shared rollouts, line-level credit outperforms strategy-level scores on screening measures; iterated, it cuts the median citation-containing set from 768 to under 50 and places more citations in sets under 100 documents th

translated_title: 教语言模型利用检索反馈收窄布尔式专利检索
translated_abstract: 专利现有技术检索人员逐行发布布尔查询，先扩大检索范围以找到相关文献，再逐步收窄，直到候选文献数量可供筛选。我们将 38,397 份日本专利局检索报告提炼为可执行的专家策略，重新执行这些策略，并通过引用召回率以及包含每条引用文献的最小文献集合来评估生成的策略。通过提示词驱动的模型能够写出有效且高召回率的策略，但会把引用文献留在规模过大、无法人工筛选的文献集合中。我们从打分的执行轨迹中以两种形式对生成器进行离线适配：一种是从筛选感知的策略分数中进行策略级学习；另一种是从“保留引用的收窄信用”中进行行级学习，即对那些将已找到的引用文献保留在更小集合中的查询行赋予更高权重。在共享的执行轨迹上，行级信用在筛选相关指标上优于策略级分数；经过迭代优化，它将包含引用文献的集合规模中位数从 768 降至 50 以下，并将更多引用文献置于少于 100 篇文献的集合中。
tldr: 该论文利用日本专利局检索报告提炼专家策略，并提出行级“保留引用的收窄信用”学习方法对语言模型进行离线迭代优化，使其生成的布尔专利检索策略在保持引用召回率的同时大幅收窄候选集合，将包含引用文献的中位数集合规模从 768 篇降至 50 篇以下。
en_tdlr: The paper distills 38,397 Japan Patent Office search reports into executable Boolean search strategies and adapts language models offline via line-level citation-preserving narrowing credit, enabling generated queries to maintain high citation recall while cutting the median citation-containing set from 768 to under 50 documents.
